csv_row.description: Generate freight documents (Bill of Lading, Rate Confirmation) and check carrier/broker compliance via FMCSA. Track insurance expiries and authority status. Use when a broker needs to generate a BOL or Rate Con, wants to verify carrier compliance, needs to check upcoming document expiries, or when booking a load. Triggered by phrases like "generate BOL", "generate rate con", "compliance check MC#", "upcoming expiries", or "document for load".
csv_row.name: freight-compliance-docs
